page.overview:
Who is Bats?

Bats are a flying mammal species native to Earth. Despite popular conception, they are not rodents, but instead, the sole members of the order Chiroptera.

Bats are most common in TMNT media as anthropomorphic characters, whether mutants or aliens. However, there are some instances in which normal bats have been present, mostly as enemies in video games.

Winged Rabid Bat is just called "bat" (バット) in the game's Japanese version, despite it looking significantly different from any real-world species of bat.

Bats are a common enemy in cave levels set on Earth, and also appear as opponents in Battle Nexus mode.
